2014_subclasses.swashbuckler.description: Swashbucklers are charismatic duelists who rely on charm and wit as much as they do on their blades. They are often found in the courts of nobles, where they use their skills to navigate the treacherous waters of politics and intrigue.
2014_subclasses.swashbuckler.fancy-footw: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you learn how to land a strike and then escape retaliation. During your turn, if you make a melee attack against a creature, that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.
During your turn, if you make a melee attack against a creature, that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn. (action).
2014_subclasses.swashbuckler.rakish-auda: Starting at 3rd level, your confidence propels you into battle. You can give yourself advantage on a Charisma (Persuasion) check if you have not yet done so this encounter. In addition, you don't need advantage on your attack roll to use your Sneak Attack against a creature if you are within 5 feet of it, no other creatures are within 5 feet of you, and you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll. All the other rules for Sneak Attack still apply to you.
In addition, you don't need advantage on your attack roll to use your Sneak Attack against a creature if you are within 5 feet of it, no other creatures.
2014_subclasses.swashbuckler.panache.des: At 9th level, your charm becomes exceedingly persuasive. As an action, you can make a Charisma (Persuasion) check contested by a creature's Charisma (Intimidation) check. The creature must be able to hear you, and you must share a language with it. If you succeed, the creature is charmed by you for 1 minute. While charmed, the creature is friendly to you and your allies. If you fail, the creature is immune to your Panache for 24 hours.
2014_subclasses.swashbuckler.panache.sum: The creature is immune to your Panache for 24 hours. (action).
2014_subclasses.swashbuckler.elegant-man: Starting at 13th level, you can use a bonus action on your turn to gain advantage on the next Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Strength (Athletics) check you make during the same turn.
Starting at 13th level, you can use a bonus action on your turn to gain advantage on the next Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Strength (Athletics) check you make during the same.
2014_subclasses.swashbuckler.duelist-s-d: Starting at 17th level, your mastery of the blade allows you to turn defense into offense. When you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your AC against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss.
Can use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your AC against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss. (reaction).
